core.headline: First-floor flat with lift, parking and Juliet balcony
core.listing:
A two-bedroom first-floor purpose-built flat in Chatham with a lift, one allocated parking space and a Juliet balcony. The accommodation comprises an open-plan kitchen/living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom.

The open-plan kitchen/living room provides the main living space and opens onto a Juliet balcony. There are two bedrooms and a bathroom.

The property benefits from one allocated parking space and lift access.

Guide Price £195,000. Leasehold with 99 years remaining and a service charge of £1,450 per year (y/e Mar 2026). Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. FTTC broadband and good outdoor mobile coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
